### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **49** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **23** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/integration.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/integration.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**17** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json da93a8b3e0bfa0ac5d4d68059b419435eb7c8371`.

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **23** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/integration.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/integration.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **15** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **137** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json da93a8b3e0bfa0ac5d4d68059b419435eb7c8371` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f3801fbee5d8555bebcd4a4d16fd10c6eae0185d` — the merge of head `674abedfd9b5a7b139cb13434673ea1f92c7947e` into base `da93a8b3e0bfa0ac5d4d68059b419435eb7c8371`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f3801fbee5d8555bebcd4a4d16fd10c6eae0185d && git checkout f3801fbee5d8555bebcd4a4d16fd10c6eae0185d
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin da93a8b3e0bfa0ac5d4d68059b419435eb7c8371 674abedfd9b5a7b139cb13434673ea1f92c7947e && git checkout -B drift-repro da93a8b3e0bfa0ac5d4d68059b419435eb7c8371 && git merge --no-ff 674abedfd9b5a7b139cb13434673ea1f92c7947e

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json da93a8b3e0bfa0ac5d4d68059b419435eb7c8371
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs da93a8b3e0bfa0ac5d4d68059b419435eb7c8371` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `674abedfd9b5a7b139cb13434673ea1f92c7947e`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #20281 (body + all six comments: triage `5859569880`, decision request `5903692970`, ruling `5904845660`, claim `5913026572`, dev report `5916207829`, seat ruling `5916259513`); PR #20903 body, 51-file list, and the net diff of `674abedfd9` against its merge-base with `main` (`33b6e8bece`, 1960/1130); the 46 check-runs on the head; `git show` / `git grep` / `git log` on the fetched refs. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**A. Accept-set and public-surface changes the diff implies — each judged**

- `Connector.syncConfig`, `Connector.fieldMappings`, and the same two keys on `DeclarativeConnectorEntry`: accepted-and-stored → refused at parse (`invalid_type` from `retiredKey()`, path = the key, message = the prescription) and in `tsc`. Both keys sit on the private `ConnectorBaseSchema` so both carriers, `stack.connectors[]`, the `/meta/connector` door (`getMetadataTypeSchema('connector')`) and `AutomationEngine.registerConnector(def: Connector)` (which runs `ConnectorSchema.parse(def)`, engine.ts:3859) all refuse. **Right.** Every door is pinned with a lit control in `connector-sync-retirement.test.ts`.
- `DataSyncConfigSchema`, `SyncStrategySchema`, `ConnectorConflictResolutionSchema`, `ConnectorFieldMappingSchema` and their `DataSyncConfig`, `DataSyncConfigParsed`, `SyncStrategy`, `ConnectorConflictResolution`, `ConnectorFieldMapping`, `ConnectorFieldMappingParsed` aliases leave `@objectstack/spec/integration` (api-surface: exactly those 10 lines; export-origins, declaration-map and the JSON-schema manifest agree; `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR[18]` gains the four defs). **Right** — an exported value schema with no carrier reads as a capability, the same rule the tree already applies to `ConnectorHealth` / `ConnectorTrigger`.
- `Mapping.connectorSource` added: a `strictObject` (`connector` name-pattern = `ConnectorSchema.name`'s, `action` non-empty, optional `input` record, optional `recordsPath`, optional `watermark { field, param }` with both halves required), no `.default()` anywhere, aliases for the near-miss spellings, a `guidance` table refusing `schedule` / `cron` / `interval` (points at `job` and `Job.schedule`), `deleteMode` / `conflictResolution` / `direction` (version 1 is a one-way pull writing through `mode` / `upsertKey`), `strategy` (full vs incremental is whether `watermark` is set) and `auth` / `credentialRef` (the connector instance holds the credential). **Right**, and `strict-object.ts` supports `guidance` (line 155). The key name avoids `Mapping`'s existing `source → sourceFormat` alias (mapping.zod.ts aliases block, verified); `fieldMappings` stays a string alias of `fieldMapping` on the mapping and the walk's matcher treats it as such. `authorable-surface/data.json` gains `data/Mapping:connectorSource`. **Right.**
- `RENAMED_DEFS` loses `integration/FieldMapping → integration/ConnectorFieldMapping` and `integration/ConflictResolution → integration/ConnectorConflictResolution`: **right and forced** — `checkRenameTable` refuses a rename whose target the build no longer emits (the `integration/RateLimitConfig` precedent in the same file).
- `authorable-defaults/integration.json` loses the 8 rows for `DataSyncConfig` / `ConnectorFieldMapping` defaults: **right** — no residue is owed because neither retired KEY carried a default of its own (the nested defaults leave with their defs).
- Liveness: `connector.json` collapses `syncConfig` (8 drilled rows) and `fieldMappings` (7, `transform` tombstone included) into two leaf `dead` tombstone rows (the `health` precedent; the gate refuses `children` on a non-container); `mapping.json` gains `connectorSource` `planned` + `authorWarn` + `authorHint` with 7 drilled `planned` rows; state-counts `connector` 31/0/0/23/1/55 → 31/0/0/10/1/42, `mapping` 14/0/0/0/0/14 → 14/0/0/0/6/20. **Right**; `Spec property liveness` is green and the counts are pinned by the new test. The README `connector` row's dead partition (`metadata` + nine tombstones = 10) and its nine-tombstone list are re-derived, not carried. **Right.**
- `cron-typed-positions-retirement.test.ts`: `integration/DataSyncConfig:schedule` moves from the strip pins to `LEFT_WITH_THEIR_DEFS`; the 2026-09-10 直接删 ruling on the KEY is preserved (still no key-level registration, conversion or D3 names `schedule`; the D2 test pins that a stored cadence leaves with the container in the container's own notice, `from: 'syncConfig'`). The manifest-reachable path becomes louder (refusal at the container) rather than silent. **Right** — this is a consequence of retiring the container, not a reversal of the ruling.
- `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` 780 → 778 (two M78 enum pins leave with their schemas; Spot 2 re-pointed at `RetryConfig`): **right**; `build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts` fixtures re-pointed at `integration/RetryConfig` and `data/FieldMapping` (same root, same depth, 4 keys carried so the rename fixture stays non-vacuous): **right**; `test-typecheck-debt.json` shrinks by one (`SyncStrategySchema` unused-import row): **right**.
- Reference docs regenerated (index 1525 → 1521 schemas, integration page 16 → 12, `mapping.mdx` gains the `connectorSource` nested-shape table): **right**, and the head's last commit is the regeneration on the merged tree.

**B. The binding against each execution parameter of ruling `5904845660`**

- No cadence key: none declared; `schedule` / `cron` / `interval` refused by guidance naming `job` / `Job.schedule` (`system/job.zod.ts:192` carries `schedule` with `expression`). **Met.**
- No credential contract: none declared; `auth` / `credentialRef` refused, pointing at the instance's ADR-0097 `auth`. **Met.**
- `rest` / `openapi` only: stated in `connector`'s describe text, the ledger row and every prescription. Not structurally enforced — the schema takes a name and nothing resolves it to a provider (a cross-item check belongs to stage ②'s reader or a lint). **Met at spec level**; see the "validated at authoring" note below.
- One-way pull: no `direction` key; refused by guidance. **Met.**
- Full or timestamp-incremental: `watermark` optional, no `strategy` switch; `field` + `param` structurally paired. **Met.** `field` / `param` map onto what the rest `request` action returns and takes: `packages/connectors/connector-rest/src/rest-connector.ts:172` builds `baseUrl + path + query`, returns `{ status, ok, body }` (line 68 / 200 in openapi), and the openapi provider keys actions by `operationId` (openapi-connector.ts:209) — so `action: 'request'` on `rest`, an operation key on `openapi`, and `recordsPath` defaulting to `body` are all true of the tree.
- Declared not executed: every row `planned`, container `authorWarn`; `lintLivenessProperties` is registered with `commands: ALL` at advisory tier (`authoring-rules.ts:1501`), walks `{ type: 'mapping', key: 'mappings' }` (lint-liveness-properties.ts:510), and `validate.ts:461` / `compile.ts:494` (the `build` command) run it — so "`os validate` / `os build` warn when it is authored" is true on `main` the moment this PR lands.
- Tombstones + one D2 + one D3 in the spec stage: `connector-sync-keys-removed` (toMajor 18, `retiredFromLoadPath`, order 50 — unique in `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS`; rationale fragment order 52 — unique) strips via `mapCollection` / `stripKeys`, one notice per key, never writes a mapping; fixture 3 connectors / 3 notices; the rehydration-seam pin asserts the row comes back key-for-key minus the two keys and parses on the tombstoned door; a second replay yields 0 notices and the same reference. **Lossless and idempotent, pinned.** `connector-sync-keys-retired` is the family's one D3 entry, naming the D2 id, `connectorSource` and `job`. **Met.**
- `retiredAfter: '17.5.0'` while every sibling major-18 entry says `17.4.0`: **right** — `types.ts:262` defines it as the package's version label at the moment the retirement lands, and `packages/spec/package.json` reads `17.5.0` on both base and head.
- Registry hunks additive against `main` after #20868: `git diff` numstat is +141/−0 (migrations) and +94/−0 (conversions); `view-item-options-bag-refused` survives at registry.ts:18495; `9905e61ca2` is an ancestor of the merge `9eec71f925` (main side `ca5408c629`), and no branch commit before that merge touches either registry — the hunks first appear in `8e0f4886c5`. **The serial constraint held.**
- `SYNC_ARCHITECTURE.md` 494 → 464 lines, and no sentence on the head file presents connector sync as delivered: the L1 and L2 "what to use instead" bullets, the L3 feature list (now a ❌ line), the new "Data sync is defined on the target" section, both example blocks, the decision matrix rows, Pattern 1 / 2, and the migration section all say declared / not yet executed, and the doc-compile pin (`connector-author-shape.test.ts`) compiles both typescript blocks. The `After` example's `type: 'api'` is a `ConnectorType` member (connector.zod.ts:737), `provider: 'rest'` + `providerConfig.baseUrl` is what the rest factory reads, and `recordsPath: 'body.items'` is coherent with the `{ status, ok, body }` return.

**C. Author-shown and AI-facing text, sentence by sentence — what is false, unsourced or over-broad, and when each is true**

Tested: both tombstone prescriptions, the four `RETIRED_DEFS` and four `RETIRED_KEYS` entry comments, the D2 docblock and summary, the D3 `surface` / `replacement` / `reason` / `acceptanceCriteria`, the STEP18 rationale fragment, the `connectorSource` TSDoc and every `.describe()`, the guidance strings, the two ledger notes and the README rows, the rewritten `SYNC_ARCHITECTURE.md`, the regenerated `connector.mdx` / `mapping.mdx` text, the changeset, and the PR body. All state facts the tree holds at this head; the measurements they cite (two comment hits for `syncConfig` outside `packages/spec`, zero for `fieldMappings`, the automation service's declared-connector item carrying neither key, `connectorInstanceSignature` at plugin.ts:290, `retryConfig` as the lit control read by `connector-fetch-policy.ts`, hard deletes only per `object.zod.ts`'s `softDelete` guidance, `runImport` at `packages/rest/src/import-runner.ts:374`) check out. "Removed in @objectstack/spec 17" and `os migrate meta --from 17` follow the five sibling tombstones on the same schema (the package is 17.5.0; the next 17.x release is the first to refuse; `applyMetaMigrations(from, to)` runs the step-18 chain from 17). Four sentences carry imprecision, none blocking:

1. "the key's input type is `never`" (tombstone TSDoc, changeset, `sync-retirement.test.ts` title) — `retiredKey()` is `z.never().optional()`, so the measured tsc diagnostic is "not assignable to type 'undefined'", which `connector-author-shape.test.ts` pins and says so. House shorthand used verbatim by the five existing tombstones in the same file; true as shorthand on `main` now.
2. `connector.mdx` (generated from the schema header): 'The "REMOVED: connector-attached sync" section below records the measurement.' — true in `connector.zod.ts`, where the block is a comment; on the generated page there is no such section, so "below" dangles. The neighbouring precedent sentence names the file instead. Cosmetic; fix at the next header touch by naming the file.
3. D3 `acceptanceCriteria`: "a `mapping` whose `connectorSource` names a `rest` or `openapi` connector instance, validated at authoring" — `MappingSchema` validates the binding's shape at authoring; nothing at this head checks that the named connector exists or that its provider is `rest` / `openapi`. True of the shape today; true of the provider restriction only once stage ② (or a lint) resolves the name. An upgrading author should read "validated" as shape validation.
4. `SYNC_ARCHITECTURE.md` Best Practices, two untouched bullets — "Test authentication and sync flows thoroughly" and "Document field mappings and business logic" — read stale under an L3 that now carries no sync and no field mapping. Not a delivery claim; carry to the next docs touch.

One more reading note: the code comments and the changeset cite "measured on `origin/main` before the removal" without a sha; the reading of record with its tree (`793fb8390e`) is in the two ledger notes and the dev report. The AGENTS.md count-plus-tree rule is satisfied by the instrument, not by the comment text.

`.changeset/20281-connector-sync-moved-to-mapping.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': minor` with a BREAKING banner, the FROM → TO table, the one-line fix, the `os migrate meta --from 17` sentence, a "runtime behaviour unchanged" note, the out-of-repo consumer caveat, and the adr-0087 `registered` marker naming `connector-sync-keys-removed, connector-sync-keys-retired` (the form `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:62` reads).
